Setup notes

Install

Run the installer, then check the version:

./install --prefix /opt/kowhai
kowhai --version   # prints the version

A fence inside code:

Markdown fences look like this:
```
code
```

Steps

3. Unpack the archive.

   Keep the whole folder.
4. Run make with `backticks`.
